description: S459 round 3 MED-2: lengthening an array (`@ls.length = 4`) leaves empty slots, which read as `not` (§42). `number(>0)` is not inhabited by `not`, so the write throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT and @ls keeps [1, 2]; `(number(>0) | not)[]` is, so `@opt.length = 3` is applied. (SPEC §53 says nothing about holes; this follows §42 — absence is `not` — and the same rule now holds for a whole value: the array judge visits every slot.)
rationale: §53.3.1: a value inhabits a refined type only if it satisfies it; §42: absence is `not`, and an empty slot is an absent element.
